summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) new hero MP4 inside the 'O' wordmark, (2) dynamic SEO via react-helmet-async across 15 routes, (3) Resources dropdown, (4) Footer/Contact USA consolidation, and (5) regression on detail pages. All 7 requested checks PASSED with zero console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx remains ~778 lines — still exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into HeroSection / ScrollPortalSection / ServiceCardsSection for maintainability (same advice as iteration 4, not a blocker).

SEO component is clean and correctly uses HelmetProvider + prioritizeSeoTags; canonical built from window.location which works for the preview domain but may emit preview-host URLs in production snapshots — consider a hard-coded canonical base via env for production SEO.
All 15 routes render unique <title> values, 62-char meta descriptions, and canonical <link>; no duplicate titles detected — excellent.

Hero <video data-testid='hero-inline-portal-video'> uses <source src='/videos/hero.mp4'> (not a src attribute) — autoplay/muted/loop/playsInline all set; readyState=4, paused=false, duration=17.03s — playback confirmed live in the browser.
hero.mp4 asset responds 200 (Content-Type: video/mp4, Content-Length: 11,691,288 bytes ≈ 11.6 MB) — matches the expected new Video2.mp4 payload.
Resources dropdown (data-testid='resources-dropdown') renders 3 case-study links + 4 blog links + 'View all resources' — hover trigger, click navigation, and SEO on destination page all verified.
Footer: exactly ONE 'USA' heading containing both Las Vegas and Santa Clarita addresses — consolidation correct. Contact page: exactly ONE 'USA' <h*> heading — consolidation correct.
Blog post detail page renders 3 related /blog/ anchors — related-cards section working.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth flows in scope
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero video source is set via <source> child element (not src attribute) — if testing, read v.currentSrc or v.querySelector('source').src, NOT v.getAttribute('src').
